itens.trecho: Uma das comédias mais bem feitas dos anos Oitenta. Há filmes feitos apenas para entreter, que não são feitos para serem grandes, mas acabam por ser tão queridos do público que resistem ao passar do tempo e continuam a conquistar apreciadores. Penso que este filme é um desses.

Oh, if only I was still young enough to wish I was older! That’s the problem facing the young “Josh” (David Moscow) who just wants to get all the school and puberty malarkey over and done with. Well a strange looking slot machine called “Zoltar” offers him a wish in return for his quarter.
Love this movie growing up. Everytime I went to a fair I was always hoping to find a machine like this. Still one of my favorite movies of all time.
